title: Lightborn Inheritance Revelation
subtitle: Uncover your true pre-Collapse royal bloodline
loreBackground: Ancient encrypted records (.arch) in the Central Library suggest that your signal signature matches the lost Seraphima bloodline from the Purge era. Unsealing these files reveals forbidden historical truths about the AETHERCORE.

steps.text: Locate Purge_Era_Genealogy.arch in Central Library archives
Acquire Lineage Key 'lightborn' or reach Cryptography Lv 2
Decrypt encrypted lineage file in Document Modal or AureScanner

dialogueHooks.briefing: Aelita: 'Your signal feels... unusual. There are pre-Collapse genealogical files locked under heavy ciphers.'
dialogueHooks.progress: Search the library archives for .arch files containing Seraphima lineage markers.
dialogueHooks.completion: Lineage verified: You hold inherited resonance clearance for AETHERCORE subterranean conduits!

title: Aureline Faction Supremacy
subtitle: Forge bonds and align with Aureline's major power centers
loreBackground: Power in Aureline is divided between the Digital Governance Agency (DGA), Cycademy of Sciences, and the VectorNet underground. Navigating faction relations shapes world events and grants exclusive access.

steps.text: Complete DGA Civic Onboarding registration
Reach 70 Trust with Jeremie (VectorNet) and 80 Trust with Dr. Voss (FaithMed)
Declare house tag affiliation on Mai.space network

dialogueHooks.briefing: DGA Notice: 'Citizens who maintain strong faction standings receive priority clearance and resource stipends.'
dialogueHooks.progress: Increase friendship and trust vectors with key faction representatives in Comms.
dialogueHooks.completion: Faction Envoy status recognized across all Aureline municipal districts.

title: Master Protocol Weaving
subtitle: Master cyber-magic crafting in the SpellForge Matrix
loreBackground: By combining elemental logic blocks (.mod) in SpellForge, weavers craft compiled reality protocols (.spell) capable of stabilizing data bleeds, dispelling PRISM malware, and boosting aura shields.

steps.text: Combine Firewall.mod and Compression.mod in SpellForge
Compile 3 custom protocol spells
Reach Spellcasting Level 3

dialogueHooks.briefing: Hex: 'Code and magic are two sides of the same frequency coin. Forge your first protocol spell.'
dialogueHooks.progress: Collect .mod files from File Explorer and drag them into the SpellForge canvas.
dialogueHooks.completion: Master Protocol Weaver title bestowed. Advanced spell block recipes unlocked!

title: Seraphima Lineage Restoration
subtitle: Reclaim the ancient pre-Collapse crown archive
loreBackground: The Purge era shattered the Seraphima crown records across subterranean network relays. Reconstructing the 4 ancestral lineage keys unlocks the royal Orynvell vault and restores your heir standing.

steps.text: Collect Ancestral Lineage Keys from Sub-Aureline relays
Submit Proof of Lineage Signature (.sig) to Archivist Rowan
Unlock royal archive access on records.orynvell.gov

dialogueHooks.briefing: Rowan Lark: 'The crown archives have lain dormant since the Collapse. Your signal holds the royal cipher key.'
dialogueHooks.progress: Trace ancestral lineage signatures across restricted historical nodes.
dialogueHooks.completion: Seraphima royal lineage restored! Royal archive access unlocked.

title: Subterranean AETHERCORE Awakening
subtitle: Re-ignite the subterranean energy core grid beneath Old Factory Ward
loreBackground: The subterranean AETHERCORE power grid has lain dormant for decades, causing Veil leaks and Veilwilt outbreaks. Re-igniting the core grid stabilizes regional energy and purges PRISM corruption.

steps.text: Inspect Substation_Nodes.grid in Spatial Explorer
Execute terminal command: sys_aethercore --ignite --frequency=88.2MHz
Purge PRISM corruption level below 1.0%

dialogueHooks.briefing: Riven: 'The lower industrial grids are leaking Veil noise. We need someone who can ignite the core.'
dialogueHooks.progress: Access the subterranean terminal node and execute core ignition.
dialogueHooks.completion: AETHERCORE re-ignited! Subterranean energy core grid online.

title: Founding Day Protocol
subtitle: Annual March 6 festival & secret archive unveiling
prerequisite: Month of March / Active World Event
loreBackground: During the Founding Day festival, historical vaults are temporarily unsealed. Uncover royal coronation logs, hidden AETHERCORE subterranean conduits, and rare ceremonial credits.

steps.text: Access records.orynvell.gov during Founding Day
Inspect Deed Record #DEED-99401 for Subterranean Conduit Sector 7
Claim Founding Day ceremonial credit stipend

dialogueHooks.briefing: Broadcast: 'Founding Day is live! Public records vault is open for citizen inspection.'
dialogueHooks.progress: Open Browser and navigate to records.orynvell.gov to claim archives.
dialogueHooks.completion: Founding Day archives secured! Claimed 500 ₡ bonus.

title: Aura Flux Outbreak Containment
subtitle: Emergency triage during dimensional energy spike
loreBackground: A sudden Veil-thinning event causes student aura corruption across Cycademy dorms. Faith Medical requires emergency diagnostic scans (.diag) to triage patients and stabilize the contagion.

Purge Veilwilt & Sunspire Burn Fever conditions
Review Patient Log #FM-88392 for recovery telemetry

dialogueHooks.briefing: Dr. Sharon: 'Aura flux is spiking in Sector 3! We need immediate telemetry scans from all active citizens.'
dialogueHooks.progress: Run intake diagnostic scan at faithmed.aure to restore Aura Integrity.
dialogueHooks.completion: Outbreak contained! Aura Integrity restored to 100%.

subtitle: Explore secret netrunner subterranean relays
loreBackground: The subterranean sub-conduits contain unregistered packet sniffers and illicit netrunner relays. Bypass DGA security wardens to intercept classified data packets.

Intercept encrypted frequency on 88.2 MHz
Bypass DGA Warden Bot without triggering 3 investigation flags

dialogueHooks.progress: Activate encrypted sub-channel in Comms and run packet intercept.
dialogueHooks.completion: Sub-conduit infiltration successful! Data packets secured.

subtitle: Represent Aureline to visiting Meridion heirs
